day.outOfRange: This date is outside the 1800–2199 range the algorithm supports.
day.note: Astronomical algorithm for Vietnam's UTC+7 time zone, suitable for everyday reference; for official purposes, check the calendar published by the competent authorities. lunar.noSuchDayLeap: This date doesn't exist (that year has no leap version of this month).

address.resultNote: The province is recognized in any part, including abbreviations (TP.HCM, HN…). The district level is dropped. A commune/ward is converted only when the data points to exactly one new commune; if the old commune was split, the options are listed for you to choose.
address.verifiedNote: Signed mapping set, effective from {{date}}. Source: {{source}}. Confirm the final address with the office receiving your documents.
address.manualNote: Mapping table entered by you; not verified by the system. Confirm the final address with the office receiving your documents.
address.addressesLabel: One address per line, levels separated by commas
address.addressesPlaceholder: 12 Lê Lợi, Phường A, Quận B, Tỉnh C
address.rulesNone: There's no signed, currently valid address mapping set on the system yet.
address.manualLabel: Or enter your own, one per line: “old province|old district|old commune|new province|new commune”
address.manualInvalid: The mapping table has the wrong format (each line needs 5 parts, each up to 150 characters) or an old province is mapped to two different new provinces.
